1	# Symbolic Dynamics research workflow
     2	
     3	Active procedure, 2026-09-05. Read this for research execution, not every
     4	status question. Batch-specific contracts and accepted evidence retain their
     5	scope; historical evaluation schemas remain unchanged.
     6	
     7	## Recover and choose the next obligation
     8	
     9	`SYMBOLIC_DYNAMICS_STATE.md` identifies the batch; its `PIPELINE_STATE.md`
    10	identifies the milestone, remaining work and controlling evidence. Read the
    11	relevant original before using a claim. Retrieve history by literal update,
    12	conjugacy/factor map and proof mechanism, rather than loading every old log.
    13	Read selected instruction files completely; search evidence files narrowly.
    14	
    15	For a continuation, finish the active batch. For a requested next round after
    16	completion, start five fresh seats with numbering after the recorded maximum.
    17	A report/review request remains read-only unless changes are also requested.
    18	Keep the original HP arithmetic program distinct from the current broad
    19	finite-system track. Neither a short-paper stage nor an internal PASS opens
    20	Route B or establishes global novelty.
    21	
    22	## Research gates
    23	
    24	1. **Scout and reject early.** Define the literal finite autonomous map and
    25	   use small exact pilots to seek a rigid temporal/recurrent structure plus
    26	   a separate inverse, fibre, enumeration or extremal mechanism. Check old
    27	   papers, killed scouts and direct primary sources. Deduct known primitives,
    28	   conjugates, factors and standard proof mechanisms. Weak signals trigger a
    29	   different system, not an automatic larger cutoff. Reserves are not papers.
    30	2. **Admit and write.** Freeze a bounded theorem contract only after deductive
    31	   proofs of its claimed all-parameter results and source/collision checks
    32	   survive the candidate gate. Write a self-contained anonymous short paper with an explicit advance,
    33	   limitations, paper-local verifier and full canonical output. Finite checks
    34	   pressure proofs; they cannot establish an all-size theorem. Freeze Round0.
    35	3. **Review and repair.** Obtain two actual process-separated manuscript
    36	   reviews. A works from Round0; accept its exact repaired or no-change delta
    37	   before freezing Round1. B works from pinned Round1 using a materially
    38	   different representation/proof route, then accepts a delta before Round2.
    39	   Authors, including proof contributors, cannot review their own paper.
    40	   Preserve input pins, independent verifier/canonical, proof/source/build
    41	   records, finding census, deltas and complete nonself manifests. Root checks
    42	   the original evidence and performs the required successful replays.
    43	4. **Complete and synchronize.** Each retained paper needs zero current open
    44	   findings, both accepted rounds, two physical source-only terminal builds,
    45	   actual viewing of every final page and complete artifact checks. Run the
    46	   batch's full terminal gate before declaring exactly five papers complete.
    47	   Preserve rejected numbered drafts and explicitly unresolved historical
    48	   caveats. Refresh batch/root state and synchronize scoped work to private Git.
    49	
    50	The P197–P203 implementation contract is in the completed batch's
    51	`PROBLEM_ANCHOR.md`, `STANDING_WORKFLOW_AUTHORIZATION.md` and
    52	`HOSTILE_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md`. New batches may reference this procedure and
    53	record only their specific scope, contracts and departures; do not duplicate
    54	generic instructions across every paper. A failed admission reopens the seat.
    55	Unresolved proof or evidence defects never become PASS to meet a quota.
    56	
    57	## Verification follows the changed dependency
    58	
    59	| Change / event | Required verification |
    60	|---|---|
    61	| New theorem, map, proof or verifier | Affected mathematical checks, source/owner review and review/delta gates; finish the contractual terminal gate before completion |
    62	| Revised manuscript, bibliography or PDF | Affected claims/citations, reviewer delta and source-only builds; actually view all changed final PDF pages, and all pages for terminal acceptance |
    63	| First full-batch completion | All five contracts; required exact author/A/B replay pairs, ten terminal cold builds, complete page views and manifest closure |
    64	| Lifecycle text, index or instruction edit only | Check links, scope, changed manifests and unchanged scientific pins; prior valid mathematical/build/view evidence remains valid |
    65	| New failure, dependency change or unresolved concern | Reopen and verify its affected scope; broaden only when the evidence warrants it |
    66	
    67	Record command, exit status, inputs, complete stdout and canonical comparison
    68	for a replay. If calling a comparison byte-exact, compare raw bytes; normalized
    69	text equality is a different claim. Distinguish a new execution from checking
    70	archived evidence. A PNG's existence/hash is not a visual review. Hash-only
    71	refresh is valid only with a prior passing gate and unchanged scientific
    72	dependencies; it is never labelled a fresh numerical or visual test.
    73	
    74	The reuse key covers imported code, data, parameters, canonical output and
    75	relevant runtime settings, not just the main script. Build evidence also
    76	depends on TeX/bibliography/resources/styles and engine configuration.
    77	Incomplete provenance or a changed dependency requires fresh affected checks.
    78	
    79	Use existing batch auditors for their documented layouts. In particular,
    80	package manifests are directory-relative while review input pins may be
    81	workspace-root-relative. Do not relax parsers or overwrite frozen receipts
    82	to make a new layout pass: add a scoped, disclosed adapter when necessary.
    83	For a new batch, agree verifier/canonical/report/delta/pin roles and the
    84	auditor's expected layout before generating review packages. Keep intake
    85	notes separate from final verdicts and avoid empty template-only artifacts.
    86	
    87	## Parallel work, recovery and Git

# P212: first unfinished obligation and runtime-policy boundary

2026-09-10 UTC. DIAGNOSIS ONLY / NO POLICY CHANGE / HOLD_OPERATIONAL / HOLD_EXTERNAL.

contributor and author of the compared P213 policy. This is not a nonauthor

## 1. The first unfinished manuscript obligation

**Initial source-only P212 build, actual all-page view and physical Round0**
are the first unfinished manuscript deliverable. The first incomplete
contracted prerequisite is **S0_QUERY_RUNTIME_AND_OPTIONS**, leading to a
fresh article[10pt]/plain/array/T1 dependency key. It is not another
mathematical pilot, another author canonical, or another strict author pair.

The [accepted strict-pair receipt](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_author_pair_runtime_reception01/RECEPTION.md:1)
already receives two complete author outputs and all three raw comparisons,
with explicit unchanged-key semantic reuse; its line 91 names the initial
build as next. The [execution-amendment receipt](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_execution_scope_amendment_root01/RECEPTION.md:14)
also records the actual preserved/application delta to sections/05_scope.tex.
Thus the earlier plan's pending execution-prose amendment is no longer work
to repeat. Neither accepted event supplied a PDF or Round0.

The [initial plan](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_initial_build_preparation01/PLAN.md:8)
and [its controlling reception](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_initial_build_source_root01/RECEPTION.md:48)
identify the real change from P211: article[10pt], plain bibliography,

plain.bst/array.sty/query-role gaps; it is not a current P212 lock.
The old build plan's seven substitutions are expressly not a finished adapter.

The [selector contract](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_build_dependency_source_preparation01/SELECTOR_OBLIGATIONS.json:22)
orders the unfinished work: S0 runtime/options; S1 complete returned bodies;

format/kernel/configuration; S5 native/render tools; S6 fresh lock and actual
build cwd. Its actual_evidence=null fields are the frozen source proposal's
historical state, not a new query of future artifacts. The later
[accepted source receipt](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_keyed_stdin_source_root01/RECEPTION.md:119)
still leaves those operative gates before initial build/view/Round0.

## 2. What the 164-target / fourteen-field observer actually does

Its relation is **indirect and implementation-contractual**:

> finite pre-probe key → separately received Python/Node diagnostics and
> full pre-Node/tool key → contract01 help/version → separately accepted
> option semantics → lookup/body phases → P212 build dependency closure.

The current [SOURCE_CONTRACT](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_keyed_stdin_source_delta01/SOURCE_CONTRACT.md:12)
limits contract01 to two kpsewhich calls, --help and --version.
Success opens neither lookup nor build. Its lines 74–83 require an
independent finite key before author runtime probes and a different complete
fourteen-field key before Node/tool execution. The
[RUNTIME_PREPARATION](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_keyed_stdin_source_delta01/RUNTIME_PREPARATION.md:45)
makes the dependency concrete: ctypes/_ctypes/libffi and six Node builtins;
actual ABI/statx comparison, module/maps/settings and relevant tool/config
keys; then separately received inner/outer bindings. The observer does not
execute verify.py or establish a mathematical claim.

| Scope | Mandatory now, and why |
|---|---|
| Scientific/replay evidence | Exact map/proofs, bounded parameters, standalone author/A/B verifiers, actual complete outputs, raw comparisons, relevant imported code/data/settings and change-sensitive reuse. No global native-birthtime requirement is stated by the general paper/review contract. |
| P212 build evidence | Actual P212 class/package/font/style/format/config/tool resources and effective build-cwd settings; source-only execution, complete native/log/FLS/BibTeX evidence, diagnostics and actual page viewing. Historical P211 coverage cannot substitute. |
| Selected S0 implementation | All admitted targets/components, actual mask coverage and fourteen-field descriptors are hard requirements of this exact accepted source interface, even where later comparisons use smaller projections. They are not currently optional. |

Ordinary product/observer/Bash/env/interpreter bootstrap is an explicitly accepted assumption, not missing evidence that another observer must manufacture. [artifact/replay roles](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers204_208_sequence/ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md:8),

## 3. Bounded recommendation: a prospective S0-only policy

**Yes, a narrower justified runtime-evidence policy could support the
unchanged scientific/manuscript gates in principle. It is not accepted or
operationally usable yet, and no exact minimal host list is established here.**

Recommend that root, if it chooses this route, commission one **source-only,
contract01-only** policy/source proposal. Its deliverable should be the
smallest exact evidence interface needed to receive the two help/version
results under ordinary trusted bootstrap, not a generic audit framework.

The proposal must retain exact reviewed code/argv/cwd/environment/input
bindings, complete relevant file bytes and identities, complete actual
stdout/stderr/exit/handle records, bounded process settlement and unknown/
failure refusal. It must explicitly justify relevant loader/config/search
roles and every omitted archival candidate. Actual tool lookup semantics
and source/config/resource dependencies cannot simply disappear into the
word “trust.” If exclusion of a CUDA/config role cannot yet be justified
from permitted evidence, record that specific unresolved dependency; do not
declare it irrelevant or automatically follow another alias.

A ten-field/full-EOF/same-fd key and explicitly trusted ancestors may be a
prospective evidence choice, but only with a **new claim/schema and
independently accepted changes to every consuming contract/source branch**.
Such a key does not satisfy old fourteen-field/native-mask attestation.
Alternatively, a justified candidate-only narrowing could retain the old
field semantics; that is still a new accepted frontier, not silent deletion.
This report selects neither implementation nor a current set of omissions.

The [accepted P213 policy](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p213_minimal_observer_source_delta_root01/RECEPTION.md:61)
is evidence that this project already permits a finite-permission approach:
actual rows under finite predicates, ten real metadata fields, whole file
bytes, explicit optional absence, no leaf aliases and trusted unscanned
ancestors. Its [written contract](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p213_minimal_observer_source_delta01/CONTRACT.md:23)
expressly disclaims P212 statx/birthtime/ancestor-device and full-host closure.
That precedent is **policy only**, not P212 runtime data or a transplantable
69-file list. P212's subprocess/tool, raw-capture, empty-input and TeX/Bib/
font/rendering obligations are different. The comparison does not open,
evaluate or rely on P213's actual runtime audit.

Preserve every old strict/native failure, source, receipt and consumed grant.
The old /dev failure is explicitly unsatisfied in
[the accepted mask diagnosis](/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p212_preprobe_native_mask_root01/RECEPTION.md:38).
The old CUDA outcome remains failed under

I did not inspect the latest producer raw or the child's audit, and make no

# Symbolic Dynamics research workflow

Active procedure, 2026-09-05. Read this for research execution, not every
status question. Batch-specific contracts and accepted evidence retain their
scope; historical evaluation schemas remain unchanged.

## Recover and choose the next obligation

`SYMBOLIC_DYNAMICS_STATE.md` identifies the batch; its `PIPELINE_STATE.md`
identifies the milestone, remaining work and controlling evidence. Read the
relevant original before using a claim. Retrieve history by literal update,
conjugacy/factor map and proof mechanism, rather than loading every old log.
Read selected instruction files completely; search evidence files narrowly.

For a continuation, finish the active batch. For a requested next round after
completion, start five fresh seats with numbering after the recorded maximum.
A report/review request remains read-only unless changes are also requested.
Keep the original HP arithmetic program distinct from the current broad
finite-system track. Neither a short-paper stage nor an internal PASS opens
Route B or establishes global novelty.

## Research gates

1. **Scout and reject early.** Define the literal finite autonomous map and
   use small exact pilots to seek a rigid temporal/recurrent structure plus
   a separate inverse, fibre, enumeration or extremal mechanism. Check old
   papers, killed scouts and direct primary sources. Deduct known primitives,
   conjugates, factors and standard proof mechanisms. Weak signals trigger a
   different system, not an automatic larger cutoff. Reserves are not papers.
2. **Admit and write.** Freeze a bounded theorem contract only after deductive
   proofs of its claimed all-parameter results and source/collision checks
   survive the candidate gate. Write a self-contained anonymous short paper with an explicit advance,
   limitations, paper-local verifier and full canonical output. Finite checks
   pressure proofs; they cannot establish an all-size theorem. Freeze Round0.
3. **Review and repair.** Obtain two actual process-separated manuscript
   reviews. A works from Round0; accept its exact repaired or no-change delta
   before freezing Round1. B works from pinned Round1 using a materially
   different representation/proof route, then accepts a delta before Round2.
   Authors, including proof contributors, cannot review their own paper.
   Preserve input pins, independent verifier/canonical, proof/source/build
   records, finding census, deltas and complete nonself manifests. Root checks
   the original evidence and performs the required successful replays.
4. **Complete and synchronize.** Each retained paper needs zero current open
   findings, both accepted rounds, two physical source-only terminal builds,
   actual viewing of every final page and complete artifact checks. Run the
   batch's full terminal gate before declaring exactly five papers complete.
   Preserve rejected numbered drafts and explicitly unresolved historical
   caveats. Refresh batch/root state and synchronize scoped work to private Git.

The P197–P203 implementation contract is in the completed batch's
`PROBLEM_ANCHOR.md`, `STANDING_WORKFLOW_AUTHORIZATION.md` and
`HOSTILE_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md`. New batches may reference this procedure and
record only their specific scope, contracts and departures; do not duplicate
generic instructions across every paper. A failed admission reopens the seat.
Unresolved proof or evidence defects never become PASS to meet a quota.

## Verification follows the changed dependency

| Change / event | Required verification |
|---|---|
| New theorem, map, proof or verifier | Affected mathematical checks, source/owner review and review/delta gates; finish the contractual terminal gate before completion |
| Revised manuscript, bibliography or PDF | Affected claims/citations, reviewer delta and source-only builds; actually view all changed final PDF pages, and all pages for terminal acceptance |
| First full-batch completion | All five contracts; required exact author/A/B replay pairs, ten terminal cold builds, complete page views and manifest closure |
| Lifecycle text, index or instruction edit only | Check links, scope, changed manifests and unchanged scientific pins; prior valid mathematical/build/view evidence remains valid |
| New failure, dependency change or unresolved concern | Reopen and verify its affected scope; broaden only when the evidence warrants it |

Record command, exit status, inputs, complete stdout and canonical comparison
for a replay. If calling a comparison byte-exact, compare raw bytes; normalized
text equality is a different claim. Distinguish a new execution from checking
archived evidence. A PNG's existence/hash is not a visual review. Hash-only
refresh is valid only with a prior passing gate and unchanged scientific
dependencies; it is never labelled a fresh numerical or visual test.

The reuse key covers imported code, data, parameters, canonical output and
relevant runtime settings, not just the main script. Build evidence also
depends on TeX/bibliography/resources/styles and engine configuration.
Incomplete provenance or a changed dependency requires fresh affected checks.

Use existing batch auditors for their documented layouts. In particular,
package manifests are directory-relative while review input pins may be
workspace-root-relative. Do not relax parsers or overwrite frozen receipts
to make a new layout pass: add a scoped, disclosed adapter when necessary.
For a new batch, agree verifier/canonical/report/delta/pin roles and the
auditor's expected layout before generating review packages. Keep intake
notes separate from final verdicts and avoid empty template-only artifacts.

## Parallel work, recovery and Git

Parallelize useful independent work while keeping a local task moving.
Give each agent a question, input paths, output ownership and acceptance
criterion. Avoid concurrent edits to the same paper or central indexes;
root integrates and verifies claims. Candidate familiarity and reused code
are disclosed; process separation is not blind or external expert review.

Checkpoint decisions and evidence at milestones, not after every tool call.
Keep raw logs in artifacts and return compact results with paths to the main
thread. Change-sensitive verification does not waive required paper gates.

Resolve the mirror from `HISTORY_AND_CAVEATS.md`; inspect its current status
and exact path mapping before copying or staging. Synchronize only owned
changes, preserve unrelated work and verify the actual pushed ref. If the
remote advanced, inspect overlap before a normal merge; never force-push or
rewrite history. Record the actual commit after it exists, without a circular
self-hash claim. Private synchronization is covered by standing authorization;
external manuscript upload, submission, publication and contact remain held.

# Five-paper round after P210

Started 2026-09-08 UTC on the user's new “继续”, immediately after the
completed P205/P207/P208/P209/P210 round and its confirmed private push.
The request activates another five-paper round; it does not reopen the old one.

Question: which five finite autonomous deterministic maps beyond the
known, rejected and reserved internal surface through P210 admit both a
rigid all-parameter temporal/recurrent theorem and a materially separate
inverse, fibre, enumeration or extremal theorem?

The [project workflow](../research_state/WORKFLOW.md) controls the phase gates.
The [prior promotion criteria](../papers197_201_sequence/PROBLEM_ANCHOR.md),
[two-review protocol](../papers197_201_sequence/HOSTILE_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md)
and [artifact-role contract](../papers204_208_sequence/ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md)
are inherited with the subtraction boundary extended through P210 and all
existing killed scouts. Paper IDs begin at P211 only after actual admission;
the directory name is a working five-seat label, not five accepted IDs.

Scout widely; explicitly define the carrier and literal autonomous update.
Deduct known maps, conjugacies, factors, parameter restrictions and proof
mechanisms before claiming a contribution. Replace weak or duplicate systems.
Finite CPU runs pressure proofs and do not prove all-parameter statements.
No reserve is preselected and no quota justifies an unresolved finding.

Each retained paper needs two actual distinct nonauthor manuscript-review
processes, accepted deltas, physical Round0/1/2, complete exact author/A/B
replay evidence, two physical source-only final builds, actual all-page
viewing and complete artifact checks. The first full-batch terminal gate is
mandatory before exactly five papers are declared complete.

The project contract supersedes generic skill templates: no routine stage
confirmation, no additional generic five-reviewer panel, no GPU-training
pilot, no external-model upload or substitute simulated review. The specified
GPT-5.4 Codex MCP provider is not available in this session; current-model
Codex subagents supply disclosed process-separated scouting/review work,
not external or cross-model certification. Optional ARS runtime profiles,
inquiry/activity ledgers and automatic bibliographic API clients stay off.

Storage is constrained: the initial read-only observation found 425,005,056
free workspace bytes and 15,472,660,480 under /root. These are observations,
not reservations. Keep scout packages compact, preserve all old evidence,
avoid whole-history/worktree/host-map copies, and recheck capacity before
substantial output. Source/configuration/runtime dependencies still require
explicit provenance; compactness never excuses missing evidence.

Private scoped Git synchronization remains authorized. Resolve the currently
accepted bare role from [the prior sync acceptance](../papers204_208_sequence/qa/FIVE_PRIVATE_SYNC_ROOT_INSPECTION.md);
do not operate Git in this non-repository workspace or overwrite the old mirror.
All output remains `OWNER_AMBER / HOLD_EXTERNAL`: no public release,
external manuscript upload, submission or specialist contact.

# Hostile review and repair protocol — candidate batch after P196

Each selected paper receives two process-separated reviews after its author
verifier and Round-0 PDF are frozen.

## Review A

- independently reconstruct the literal map and complete small functional
  graphs;
- attack theorem hypotheses, boundary parameters, tail conventions, fibre
  orientation, image iff statements, and mass identities;
- audit every bibliography record and the P1--P196 subtraction boundary;
- classify findings as Critical, Major, or Minor and emit an exact delta
  record;
- if a repair is required, the same reviewer must accept or reject the repaired
  delta before Round 1 freezes.

## Review B

- start from frozen Round-1 inputs with exact SHA-256 pins;
- use a representation and proof route materially different from the author
  and Review-A implementations;
- rederive the central theorem package and replay at least two byte
  comparisons against its canonical transcript;
- independently inspect source/owner boundaries and PDF/build surfaces;
- emit an accepted no-change or repair delta before Round 2 freezes.

## Terminal rule

No paper reaches terminal PASS unless both review packages contain one
verifier, one canonical transcript, an exact zero-open-finding census, complete
input pins, proof/source/build records, an accepted delta, a non-self manifest,
and successful root replay.  All internal passes preserve
`OWNER_AMBER / HOLD_EXTERNAL`.

# Paper/review artifact roles for the new five-seat batch

This layout is fixed before the first paper review. It adapts the inherited
hostile-review procedure to modular short manuscripts without changing any
historical package or parser. Root must implement/check this layout directly;
an old-layout audit result is not reused as a new-batch PASS.

## Scientific and frozen inputs

Each numbered paper has `main.tex`, `math_commands.tex`, `sections/*.tex`,
`references.bib`, `PROOF_PACKAGE.md`, `verify.py`, and `CANONICAL.json`.
The local verifier imports no pilot, old-paper or reviewer implementation.
`PAPER_PLAN.md`, `NARRATIVE_REPORT.md`, `CLAIMS_EVIDENCE.md`, and
`SOURCE_AUDIT.md` bind framing and claim/source scope. `README.md` records
the actual lifecycle and authorship. An author execution receipt names the
complete fresh replay pair and byte comparisons.

`frozen_round0/`, `frozen_round1/`, and `frozen_round2/` are physical,
immutable copies of the respective accepted scientific/documentary input
sets, including the PDF available at that freeze. Each has a complete
directory-relative nonself `SHA256SUMS`. Freeze 1 follows accepted A delta;
freeze 2 follows accepted B delta. Rejected numbered papers remain present.

## Exactly two manuscript-review packages

Locations are `reviews/pNNN_a/` and `reviews/pNNN_b/` under this batch.
Their roles are:

| Artifact | Required content |
|---|---|
| `REPORT.md` | Exact verdict, provenance, claim-by-claim attack, finding census |
| `verify.py`, `CANONICAL.json` | One standalone independent checker and its complete actual stdout |
| `REPLAY_LOG.md` | Commands, interpreter/settings, child exit codes, complete output/byte comparison receipt |
| `SOURCE_AND_PROOF.md` | Deductive route, literal collision subtraction and primary-source contexts/read limits |
| `BUILD_REPORT.md` | Actual source-only build and actual page inspection, with input/output pins |
| `INPUT_PINS.sha256` | Complete reviewed scientific/documentary freeze inputs, workspace-root-relative |
| `FINDINGS.json` | Severity-labelled findings with exact open/resolved state; no open mathematical/evidence finding at acceptance |
| `DELTA.md` | Reviewer-accepted exact repaired or no-change delta, with before/after pins |
| `SHA256SUMS` | Complete directory-relative manifest of every review artifact except itself |

Additional real evidence such as original build logs, independently generated
tables, PNGs, or a frozen initial finding report belongs in the package and
must be covered by its manifest. Empty templates do not count as reviews.
Reviewer A starts from pinned Round 0; B starts from pinned Round 1 and uses
a materially different representation from both the author and A. The two
reviewers must be distinct nonauthor processes. Candidate-gate familiarity
is disclosed and never substituted for manuscript review.

Root inspects originals and executes each author/A/B checker twice during
the final gate, comparing actual stdout with its canonical bytes. A prior
valid pair may be reused only under the workflow's full dependency key,
with that reuse clearly labelled; the first five-paper terminal gate still
checks all five contracts.

## Terminal builds and views

`qa_final/cold_build_1/` and `cold_build_2/` begin from source-only inputs:
the live final TeX, bibliography, required local resources/styles, and no
auxiliary or PDF products. Two actual physical builds run. Record the
engine, environment settings, input/source hashes, full logs, exit codes,
page counts, unresolved-reference/citation checks, fonts, and PDF hashes.
Use explicit reproducible build settings and compare the PDFs when claiming
byte identity. Render every final PDF page and actually view it; file
existence or a digest is not a viewing receipt.

The final batch auditor checks all five admitted contracts, freezes, review
deltas, zero current findings, replay pairs, builds, all-page viewing records,
link closure and complete nonself manifests. Every internal result retains
`OWNER_AMBER / HOLD_EXTERNAL`. Private Git synchronization is a separate
evidence-backed action and never means public release.
